fusions.name: Ram the Gap
fusions.desc: Butts the target with your shield, dealing 13 damage, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Crag Slide
fusions.desc: Drives your planted shield through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to everything in it.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Plants your feet behind your shield, reducing the damage you take by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Crag Stance
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% rock resistance.
